model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата изобразява стойности за "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer" в зависимост от "Sparsity Rate". Хоризонталната ос показва "Sparsity Rate" и съдържа десет категории, разположени в азбучен ред: 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Perplexity" и използва логаритмична скала с диапазон от 0 до 10³ и равномерно разположени стойности от 1 до 1000, показващи експоненциално нарастване. Показани са две серии от стълбове, съответстващи на "Per-Output" (в светло син цвят) и "Per-Layer" (в оранжев цвят). Най-късите стълбове за "Per-Output" се намират при 10% Sparsity Rate с приблизителна стойност 2, а за "Per-Layer" също при 10% Sparsity Rate с приблизителна стойност 3. Най-високите стълбове за "Per-Output" се намират при 80% Sparsity Rate с приблизителна стойност 800, а за "Per-Layer" също при 80% Sparsity Rate с приблизителна стойност 900. Стълбовете за "Per-Output" показват последователно нарастване на височината, докато при 80% Sparsity Rate, стълбовете за "Per-Layer" показват по-бързо нарастване спрямо тези за "Per-Output".
model_annotations.Chinese: 这张柱状图展示了在不同稀疏率下，每输出和每层的困惑度。水平轴表示稀疏率，其标签为“Sparsity Rate”，刻度均匀，从 10% 到 80% 增加，递增 10%。垂直轴表示困惑度，标签为“Perplexity”，采用对数刻度，从 10^1 到 10^3 增加。该图包含两个类型的柱状图，它们按分组排列：一种类型表示“Per-Output”困惑度，颜色为浅蓝色；另一种类型表示“Per-Layer”困惑度，颜色为橙色。每组柱状图对应一个稀疏率。起始稀疏率 10% 时，“Per-Output”困惑度约为0.1，而“Per-Layer”困惑度约为0.2。在 80% 稀疏率时，“Per-Output”困惑度的值为约为 1000，而“Per-Layer”困惑度超出图表可见范围。其余的柱状图高度成逐渐上升的趋势，其中“Per-Output”始终略低于“Per-Layer”的值。该图未按任何特定方式排序，且没有对其中的任何一个柱状图进行视觉强调。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the perplexity of 'Per-Output' and 'Per-Layer' models across varying sparsity rates. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled in percentage increments from 10% to 80%, with values displayed at each 10% interval. The vertical axis is labeled "Perplexity" and utilizes a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ (1) to approximately 10³ (1000), with tick labels displayed at intervals of 10, 100, and 1000. Two sets of bars are presented; 'Per-Output' bars are colored light blue, and 'Per-Layer' bars are colored orange. The 'Per-Output' bars range in value from approximately 2 to 900, while the 'Per-Layer' bars range from approximately 1 to 850. The bars are sorted in ascending order of sparsity rate. There is a visible trend where both sets of bars increase in height progressively as the sparsity rate increases; the shortest 'Per-Output' bar corresponds to 10% sparsity and the tallest 'Per-Output' bar corresponds to 80% sparsity. The same trend is observed for the 'Per-Layer' bars, with values corresponding to the shortest and tallest bars being 1 and 850 respectively. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the distinction of color and bar length.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Per-Output- und Per-Layer-Perplexität in Bezug auf die Sparsity Rate. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Sparsity Rate und ist mit Kategorien in 10%-Schritten von 10 % bis 80 % beschriftet. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert die Perplexität und ist mit einer logarithmischen Skala von 10 hoch 1 bis 10 hoch 3 beschriftet; die y-Achse enthält Tick-Beschriftungen in einem Abstand von 0,5-Einheiten und repräsentiert 10 hoch 1, 10 hoch 2 und 10 hoch 3. Es gibt 8 Balken für die Per-Output-Perplexität, die in hellblau dargestellt sind, und 8 Balken für die Per-Layer-Perplexität, die in Orange dargestellt sind. Die Balken der Per-Output-Perplexität haben einen ungefähren Wert von 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70 und 80, während die Balken der Per-Layer-Perplexität einen ungefähren Wert von 10, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50 und 60 haben. Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge der Sparsity Rate angeordnet, und keiner der Balken ist visuell hervorgehoben.
